topics.label: Company law in Mali follows the OHADA Uniform Act on Commercial Companies and Economic Interest Groups (AUSCGIE). The most common vehicles are the SARL (limited liability company) and SA (public limited company); registration is centralised through the one-stop shop (Guichet Unique) at the API-Mali / commercial registry (RCCM).

topics.label: Mali is a West African, francophone, civil-law jurisdiction whose tax rules sit in the Code Général des Impôts (CGI) and are administered by the Direction Générale des Impôts (DGI). It is a WAEMU/UEMOA member, uses the West African CFA franc, and harmonises company law and some indirect-tax rules through OHADA and WAEMU directives.
